GetItemEquipedType.requires: ItemManager instance and inventory UUID, not gameItemId
GetItemEquipedType.behavior: First UUID match in current EquipData slots at 0x20,0x24,0x28,0x2c,0x30,0x34 returns 1..6; otherwise 0

function.uiEvidence: WeaponPropertys boxes instance signed i16 at +0x42 and master signed i16 at +0x3e without scaling in displayed branches; their localized labels are unresolved here

stability.uiEvidence: WeaponPropertys boxes master byte +0x40 without scaling in one equip branch; the label is unresolved here

range_raw.avatarCompositeRole: High byte of get_AvatarCategory; not universally a distance
range_raw.uiEvidence: No distance conversion established by the selected getters or display branch

slot_max_raw.avatarCompositeRole: Low byte of get_AvatarCategory; observed master values 0..27 are not universally slot counts
slot_max_raw.instanceRule: ItemData.get_SlotMax returns 0 for types 17..19, otherwise instance byte +0x44; this does not overwrite master raw byte
slot_max_raw.uiEvidence: WeaponPropertys tests the instance getter while rendering the two instance slot fields

limitations: Native predicates are the named helpers, not a complete equipment compatibility or legality check.
Default selected slot is not the current equipped slot; IsSubWeapon and CheckWeaponItem overlap their default slot groups.
Native equip range includes unknown numeric type 24; no guessed category is assigned to missing enum values.
Legacy ItemDBData enums and Toram.Common enums are separate declarations with preserved aliases.
CheckUseItem includes type 0 and negative values by its signed comparison; extracted master types are nonnegative.
The getter bodies can share native addresses and carry another method's label in Ghidra; metadata token and RVA identify the requested alias.
Armor customization requires an instance byte; no unrecognized master flag bits are decoded by this extraction.
Avatar category IDs are the packed getter values; no category names or account ownership are inferred.
Function as ATK/DEF, distance units, final combat stability formulas and runtime UI strings are not established here.
No process access, game changes, app changes or combat-stat formula changes are performed.
